Name: Multiplayer Lag Fixer - Skull Caverns and Mine
Author: Xoulious
Description: I figured out what variables to adjust from the no longer supported NetworkOptimizer mod uploaded by Ilyaki.  This mod should improve the network connection and give the impression of having better ping by updating clients more frequently and reducing the difference between what the client sees and what the server sees.

Manifest.Name: MultiplayerLagFixer
Manifest.Description: uses more network and lowers interpolation but makes game less laggy both visually and in combat
Manifest.Author: Xoulious
